titulo: Adjetivos 3: without an article (kalter Kaffee, gute Freunde): Without an article: nominativo e acusativo

aula.titulo: Adjetivos 3: without an article (kalter Kaffee, gute Freunde)
aula.objetivo: Give the adjective its ending when there is no article (uncountable nouns, plurals, orders and prices), using the endings of der, die, das, and put the three families of adjectives into one table.

sessao.titulo: Without an article: nominativo e acusativo

blocos.titulo: The adjective without an article, step by step
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: without an article (neither der nor ein), the ADJECTIVE has to show the case ALL BY ITSELF. STEP 2: it uses the endings of the definite article: «der» → -er, «die» → -e, «das» → -es, «die» (plural) → -e. STEP 3: nominative: kalter Kaffee (m), kalte Milch (f), kaltes Wasser (n), kalte Getränke (plural). STEP 4: accusative: only the masculine changes, as always: kalten Kaffee (-en); the rest is the same as the nominative. STEP 5: it appears without an article with UNCOUNTABLE nouns (Kaffee, Milch, Wasser, Brot, Obst), with PLURALS without an article (gute Freunde) and in orders and prices: «Ich möchte kalten Kaffee», «Wir haben frisches Brot».
blocos.comparacao: English says «cold coffee», «cold water», «good friends» without ever worrying about case. In German, with no article, the adjective carries the case with the endings of «der, die, das».

erros.motivo: With no article, the adjective carries the ending (-es).

blocos.enunciado: Say 6 sentences about food and drink without an article: «Ich möchte kalten Kaffee. Wir haben frisches Brot. Ich esse gern frisches Obst.»
Write the declined adjectives after der/die/das and after ein/mein/kein, in the nominative and accusative.
